title: When Simpler Beats Learned: Dual-Weighted Sampling vs. Machine Learning for the Pricing Subproblem in Graph Coloring
abstract: arXiv:2611.29769v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The graph coloring problem can be solved to optimality by branch-and-price (B&P), but its performance hinges on the column generation (CG) step, where each iteration requires solving a maximum weight independent set (MWIS) pricing problem. The state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) pricing heuristic follows a prediction-sampling paradigm: a learned model scores each vertex of a graph, and independent sets are sampled from the induced distribution. We observe, however, that the scoring procedure does not need to be learned, and critically assess the role of ML by replacing the learned scores with the dual solution of the restricted master problem, resulting in Dual-Weighted Sampling, a proposed lightweight alternative that requires no feature engineering or training. translated_title: 当简单方法胜过学习模型：用于图着色定价子问题的双重加权采样与机器学习之比较
translated_abstract: 图着色问题可以通过分支定价法（Branch-and-Price, B&P）求解至最优，但其性能取决于列生成（CG）步骤，其中每次迭代都需要求解一个最大权独立集（MWIS）定价问题。目前最先进的机器学习（ML）定价启发式方法遵循预测-采样范式：由学习模型对图的每个顶点进行打分，然后从由此产生的分布中采样独立集。然而，我们观察到打分过程无需通过学习获得，并通过用受限主问题的对偶解替代学习到的分数，批判性地评估了机器学习的作用，由此提出了双重加权采样——一种无需特征工程或训练的轻量级替代方案。在仅改变定价预言机的统一列生成与分支定价框架中，双重加权采样在已建立的基准测试上优于MLPH、手工设计的启发式方法和精确求解器。
tldr: 本文提出双重加权采样方法，用受限主问题的对偶解取代机器学习模型的打分，在无需特征工程和训练的情况下，在图着色列生成的定价子问题中超越了现有机器学习方法MLPH、手工启发式算法和精确求解器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dual-Weighted Sampling, which replaces learned ML scores with the dual solution of the restricted master problem, outperforming MLPH, hand-crafted heuristics, and exact solvers in the pricing subproblem of graph coloring column generation—without any feature engineering or training.
